newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech '96 trade deficit hits record CZK 160.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Czech '96 trade deficit hits record CZK 160.3 bln.

text.p: The Czech Republic finished 1996 with a record trade deficit of 160.3 billion crowns, after posting a 95.7 billion crown shortfall in 1995, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
The CSU figures showed that the trade deficit for December alone was 18.0 billion crowns, after a 14.3 billion crown deficit in the same month last year.
The deficit for the first 11 months of the year was revised to 142.33 billion crowns from a previously reported 140.147 billion crown deficit, the CSU added.
CZECH FOREIGN TRADE JAN-DEC 96 JAN-NOV 96 JAN-DEC 95
Note. All 1996 figures in billions of crowns on customs-cleared basis and subject to revision. Previously reported figures in brackets.
